decisions.statement: A patch has no time of its own.
A merged observation is stamped with the time the merge was given.
A patch field holding undefined leaves the value already there.
Counts are merged key by key rather than replaced whole.
An outcome given with no failure drops the failure that was there.
A first observation is the patch with a time on that patch.
A sweep's worst is beaten only by a longer sweep.
The worst sweep's time and trigger move together with its length.
Every count but the worst is taken from the sweep just done.

definition: one observation folded onto the last, and the worst sweep kept across every sweep so far
